name: Young Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage, even at a young age, is a God-ordained union designed for companionship and unity, as seen when God created a suitable helper for man and established that a man shall leave his parents to become one flesh with his wife (Genesis 2:18, 24). The love and commitment exemplified by Jacob’s willingness to serve for Rachel and the call to rejoice with the wife of one’s youth emphasize the deep affection and steadfastness expected in marriage (Genesis 29:18; Proverbs 5:18). Additionally, Deuteronomy instructs that a newlywed husband should have a year free from burdens to nurture his wife, highlighting the importance of care and attentiveness in the early stages of marriage (Deuteronomy 24:5).
